_help: This file tells the 3D viewer which models to show. Each model gets a tab above the viewer, in this order.
JSON does not allow comments, so the notes are here.
glb      = file in this folder, made by scripts/export_web_models.py from your Blender scenes
explode  = false: no Explode slider. true: automatic explode (parts move away from the middle).
Or set each part's movement: { "Part name": [X, Y, Z] } in mm, same axes as in Blender
(for the chamber: -X = back, +X = front, +Z = up). Parts not listed don't move.
The part name must match the name shown in the part list on the website.
caption  = one sentence shown under the viewer
Instead of glb you can list STL files: "parts": [{ "name": "Lid", "file": "lid.stl", "color": "#f2a65a" }]
(opacity less than 1 gives a glass look; "upAxis": "Y" if the STL appears lying on its side)
Careful with JSON: every item except the last one needs a comma, and text needs double quotes.
